newsitem.title: INDIA: India produced 46,525 tonnes aluminium in October.
newsitem.headline: India produced 46,525 tonnes aluminium in October.

text.p: India produced 46,525 tonnes of aluminium metal in October 1996 against a target of 47,274 for the month, the Mines ministry said in a statement on Monday.
It said 296,014 tonnes of aluminium were produced between April and October against 299,835 tonnes in the same period in 1995.
The government had fixed an aluminium production target of 309,361 tonnes for April-October 1996.
The ministry said state-run National Aluminium Co Ltd (NALCO) produced 16,629 tonnes of the metal in October against a target of 16,990 tonnes.
NALCO exported 3,352 tonnes of aluminium in October.
